name: Kohen
source:
The story of a quiet young man, Ernest Sancerre.
One day, when he returned to the mansion, all his family members were killed.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/18266]official site[/url]]
translation:
这是沉静的青年欧内斯特·桑塞尔的故事。
某天，他回到宅邸，却发现家人已全部遇害。

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/18266]官网[/url]]
